title: Norm order of an integral element equals its quotient length
statement: Let K, E, and L be fields with compatible algebra structures K → E → L, and suppose L/E is finite-dimensional and separable. Let v be a project place of E over K, A = O_v, and B = Place.integralClosureAt L v, with its canonical maps. For every nonzero b ∈ B, there exists n ∈ ℕ such that length_A(B/bB) = n in ℕ∞ and v.ord(Norm_{L/E}(b)) = n in ℤ, where b is mapped into L before taking its norm. No principal-divisor hypothesis is assumed.
lean_statement: ∀ (K E L : Type*) [Field K] [Field E] [Field L] [Algebra K E] [Algebra K L] [Algebra E L] [IsScalarTower K E L] [FiniteDimensional E L] [Algebra.IsSeparable E L] (v : AlgebraicCurve.Place K E) (b : AlgebraicCurve.Place.integralClosureAt L v), b ≠ 0 → ∃ n : ℕ, Module.length v.toValuationSubring (AlgebraicCurve.Place.integralClosureAt L v ⧸ Ideal.span ({b} : Set (AlgebraicCurve.Place.integralClosureAt L v))) = (n : ℕ∞) ∧ v.ord (Algebra.norm E (algebraMap (AlgebraicCurve.Place.integralClosureAt L v) L b)) = (n : ℤ)
